# Tennis.com

> > Comprehensive tennis coverage featuring live scores, player rankings, tournament results, and news from ATP, WTA, and ATP Challenger Tour events.

Tennis.com is the digital home of Tennis Channel, providing real-time tournament coverage from major events like the BNP Paribas Open at Indian Wells, player interviews with stars like Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz, and Aryna Sabalenka, plus gear reviews and pickleball content. The site covers the full tennis ecosystem from Grand Slams to next-gen Challenger Tour players.

## Key Topics

- BNP Paribas Open
- Indian Wells
- ATP Challenger Tour
- Jannik Sinner
- Carlos Alcaraz
- Aryna Sabalenka
- Novak Djokovic
- Iga Swiatek
- Tournament schedules
- Live scores and rankings
- Player interviews
- Match highlights
- Tennis Channel streaming
- Next-gen players
- Tennis gear reviews

## Live Scores & Tournament Coverage

- [Tennis Live Scores News Videos Player Rankings](https://www.tennis.com/index): Homepage with live scores, rankings & BNP Paribas Open results
- [Tournaments](https://www.tennis.com/tournaments/index): Complete ATP/WTA tournament schedule & calendar for 2026 season
- [Tournament Highlights & Videos](https://www.tennis.com/highlights): Tournament highlights & videos from Indian Wells featuring top players
- [Trending Tennis News](https://www.tennis.com/news/trending/index): Trending tennis news from BNP Paribas Open & Indian Wells matches
- [TC Airlines Tournament Calendar](https://www.tennis.com/tcairlines): TC Airlines tournament calendar covering Doha, Dubai & Indian Wells

## ATP Challenger Tour

- [ATP Challenger Tour Coverage](https://www.tennis.com/atpchallengertour): ATP Challenger Tour rankings, schedule & tournament coverage
- [ATP Challenger Tour Next-Gen Players](https://www.tennis.com/atpchallengertour_include): ATP Challenger Tour coverage with next-gen players like Blanch & Giron

- [Player Interviews](https://www.tennis.com/interviews_include): Player interviews & profiles from ATP Challenger and pro tennis
